documents.title: Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a 58% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 853.63 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by strong wedding and festive demand. EBITDA increased 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores with margins expanding to 11.01%. The company finalized locations for new showrooms in Dahod, Gujarat, and Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, marking its first FOCO model store. Management internal plans target around 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28 while maintaining a long-term goal of reaching 51 stores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management is internally targeting approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its vision to reach a total of 51 stores by FY30.
guidance.quote: our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan targets increasing its studded jewellery mix to 12% to 15% overall by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company aims to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30% in terms of top line by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: For FY27 and FY28, the planned revenue growth is around 20% to 25%, aiming for INR4,800 crores and INR5,500 crores respectively.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company targets an EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management targets a long-term total of around 51 stores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Total revenue in Q1 FY27 grew 58% year-on-year to INR 853.63 crores compared to INR 541 crores in Q1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases accounted for 62% of sales during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall same-store sales growth stood at 52% during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Store footfall-to-conversion ratio reached 81% in Q1 FY27 with an average ticket size of approximately Rs. 1,57,000.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across the company's markets during the quarter, driven by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India's gold demand is projected to remain between 600 and 700 tonnes in 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s gold demand is projected to remain in the range of 600–700 tonnes in 2026, with rising investment demand offsetting weaker jewellery consumption due to elevated gold prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold jewellery demand remains resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets, while rising gold prices push consumers toward lighter designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours. Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery continues to dominate the product mix at approximately 60%.
demand_outlook.quote: From a product mix perspective, wedding jewellery continues to dominate at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%, and corporate and other gifting at ~15%, reflecting a well-diversified and demand-aligned portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Same-store sales growth is approximately 20% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: So yeah, the number of the same-store sales growth is ~20% is the SSG growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth declined by around 20% overall in FY26 as growth was driven primarily by value.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contribution is currently around 35% to 40% of sales.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the old gold exchange is somewhere 35% to 40% as of now.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized showroom locations for expansion in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Dahod showroom will measure approximately 3,200 sq. ft. under a COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. operating as the company's first FOCO model store.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: Management targets adding five to six new stores in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan launched its e-commerce website and mobile application across major mobile stores.
capex_expansion.quote: This quarter, we launched our e-commerce website and mobile application, which are now available on both the Play Store and App Store.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, taking the total showroom network to 12 with a total retail store area of approximately 53,650 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12. Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned to open three to four new COCO stores and one franchise store for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Expansion is targeted across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned earlier, we are focusing on expansion across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 93.99 crores, up 70% year-on-year from INR 55 crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin increased by 82 basis points year-on-year to 7.55% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 was ₹854 crore, with EBITDA at ₹94 crore and Profit After Tax at ₹64 crore.
margins_costs.quote:
Total Revenue (₹ CR) EBITDA (₹ CR) Profit After Tax (₹ CR)

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was recorded at 11.01%.
Full year FY26 EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25, driven by better scale and operating efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25. This improvement was driven by better scale, improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 PAT margins improved to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin increased to 10% during FY26 compared to 7.72% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: the GP has been increased almost 30% as compared to the previous year where we had a GP of around 7.72% compared to with the 10% GP we have achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: D.P. Abhushan operates with an annual inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

capital_allocation.claim: The company leverages gold metal loans, exchange procurement, and commodity exchange hedging to improve working capital efficiency.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The QIP plan has been put on hold as market conditions are not currently favorable.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: More than 90% to 95% of the company's investment is in inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory.

risks_headwinds.claim: An increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality, such as lower relative demand in June and July following the conclusion of the wedding season.
risks_headwinds.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volume growth across the broader industry remained under pressure during FY26 due to high and volatile gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: This trend was largely in line with the broader industry, where volume growth remained under pressure due to high gold prices. Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile

management_commitments.claim: Management targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets adding approximately five to six new stores during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to reach a total of 51 stores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increasing its overall studded jewellery mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: The management plans to expand its footprint in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a store in Jodhpur and target Jaipur in the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are planning to open a store in Jodhpur, and Jaipur is definitely part of our future expansion roadmap. We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a total of around 51 stores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, by 2030, we are planning to have a total of around 51 stores.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next three to five years, the online and mobile application venture is targeted to contribute around 3% to 5% of top-line revenue.
management_commitments.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
